name: Instantly
summary: Cold email outreach platform with a lead database, deliverability tools, AI agents and a CRM.
description: Instantly runs cold email campaigns at scale with deliverability infrastructure such as inbox warm-up, plus a B2B lead database, email verification, website visitor identification, AI sales and reply agents, and a CRM. Managed services and done-for-you outreach setup are also offered.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: The official pricing page lists paid Outreach plans, with Growth at 42.53 €/month. No permanent free plan was shown.

howToUse.title: Open Instantly
howToUse.description: Open instantly.ai, choose Get Started or Start For Free, or book Get a Demo for a walkthrough.

howToUse.title: Launch a cold email campaign
howToUse.description: Ask Co-pilot to find leads, write copy, and generate a campaign, then launch that cold email campaign at scale.

howToUse.title: Add deliverability and lead data
howToUse.description: Use the deliverability infrastructure, including inbox warm-up, together with the B2B lead database, email verification, and website visitor identification.

howToUse.title: Hand replies to an agent
howToUse.description: Create an AI sales agent and a reply agent, and let the CRM route people who reply or visit. Managed services and done-for-you outreach setup, based on Instantly's own growth system, are also offered.

features: Cold email outreach platform with a lead database, deliverability tools, AI agents and a CRM.

Instantly runs cold email campaigns at scale with deliverability infrastructure such as inbox warm-up, plus a B2B lead database, email verification, website visitor identification, AI sales and reply agents, and a CRM.
features_fr: Plateforme de diffusion d'e-mails froids avec une base de données de leads, des outils de délivrabilité, des agents IA et un CRM.

Exécute instantanément des campagnes d'e-mails froids à grande échelle avec une infrastructure de délivrabilité telle que l'échauffement de la boîte de réception, ainsi qu'une base de données de prospects B2B, la vérification des e-mails, l'identification des visiteurs du site Web, des agents de vente et de réponse IA et un CRM.
Des services gérés sont également proposés.
description_fr: Tu gères des campagnes d'e-mails froids à grande échelle avec une infrastructure de délivrabilité (échauffement de boîte, etc.), une base de prospects B2B, la vérification d'e-mails, l'identification des visiteurs, des agents IA vente/réponse et un CRM. Des services gérés et des configurations clé en main sont aussi proposés.
